outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental pipeline, not a plot of quantified data.
Panel B shows fluorescence, H&E, and bright-field images, not a plot of averaged data.
Bar chart of lactate concentration by tissue type (Normal lung, LUAD, LUSC) shows individual data points as dots overlaid on the bars along with mean and 95% CI.
Bar chart of lactate concentration by pH region (High pH, Low pH) shows individual data points as dots overlaid on the bars along with mean and 95% CI.
Panel E is a schematic illustration of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, not a plot of quantified data.
